name: JW Marriott Marquis Hotel Dubai
insider_take: This architectural marvel isn't just a hotel – it's Dubai's tallest building and the world's second-tallest hotel, soaring 355 meters into the sky with its distinctive twin-tower design.
whats_special: The JW Marriott Marquis holds multiple world records and features 14 acclaimed restaurants and bars, including the world's highest Irish pub on the 52nd floor. Its unique curved glass facade was inspired by a date palm tree, paying homage to Dubai's heritage while representing modern luxury.
pro_tip: Book a room on floors 40+ for unobstructed views of the Burj Khalifa and Dubai Fountain, especially stunning during the nightly fountain shows at 6pm, 7pm, and 8pm.
dont_miss: The Prime68 steakhouse on the 68th floor offers 360-degree panoramic views of Dubai's skyline, while the Vault cocktail bar features Dubai's first molecular mixology program. The hotel's location in Business Bay puts you just 5 minutes from Dubai Mall and the iconic Burj Khalifa.
pros: World's tallest hotel building with stunning panoramic city views
Prime location in Business Bay with easy access to Dubai's attractions
Multiple award-winning restaurants and rooftop dining experiences
Extensive luxury amenities including spa, pools, and fitness facilities
cons: Large-scale property may feel less intimate
